history: Scripted experiment: Jacqueline faces Rotting Remains (willpower 3). Two Arcane Research copies account for her 2 starting horror. Only Patrice has a committable card: Promise of Power.
Commit Promise of Power (+4; add a curse)
Promise of Power: four wild icons bring skill to 9. Add one curse before revealing. [07032; RR ST.2]
Decline for this reveal: draw 1 token
Revealed Curse. [RR ST.3; 60401]
The resolved curse contributes −2 and requires another reveal. The prior token group stays resolved. [Innsmouth insert p1]
Use Jacqueline: reveal 3, then choose cancellations
Revealed −1, 0, −2. [RR ST.3; 60401]
Cancel −1 and 0
Skill 5 versus 3: 0 horror dealt. Resolved curses go to the pool; other revealed tokens return to the bag. [01163; RR ST.5–8; FAQ 2.5 §2.9]
